All That's Unseen: An Appalachian Memoir

Emilee Hackney
Achingly intelligent ... As she recounts growing up in the literal shadow of the Appalachians and in the figurative shadow of the Pentecostal church, she asks: Is salvation in ministry or mountains, pulpit or place? Do I belong to one or the other? To both or neither?
Harvard graduate Hackney debuts with a thought-provoking account of her early life in Appalachian Virginia ... Hackney examines the explosive intersection of charismatic Christianity, misogyny, and young love.
